2607.04926.title: Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study
2607.04926.paper_summary: How does the way information reaches a transformer -- as symbolic tokens, a clean per-factor "oracle" code, or an entangled perceptual vector -- shape whether it binds that information compositionally? We study ~6-10K-parameter transformers on finite factored worlds enumerated exhaustively, so every measurement covers the whole input space (zero sampling variance) and the informative routes are information-matched (exact Bayes ceiling 1.0). We report four findings. (1) Endpoint invariance: on held-out binding queries no informative route reaches converged zero-shot composition -- each ends at or below chance despite a ceiling of 1.0, so within a bounded sweep the failure reflects inductive bias under a lookup-sufficient objective, not missing information. (2) A two-factor account of few-shot binding: sample efficiency is best explained by input-pathway parameter sharing and code readability; a dimension-matched control and a graded readability sweep isolate readability from input dimension, and the clean oracle is not the most sample-efficient readable route. (3) A double dissociation: early in training, distributed -- but not index-like -- codes pass through a transient above-chance phase (tracking code format), while few-shot efficiency tracks pathway sharing. (4) Failure anatomy: symbolic routes lose the answer at the readout; index routes mis-bind (the answer stays decodable, yet an input intervention shows the output tracks the wrong slot); entangled routes inherit their input's readability. The central claim is the two-factor account; the endpoint and anatomy results are diagnostic constraints. All code, manifests, and per-seed logs are released for exact reproduction.
2607.04926.paper_summary_zh: 如何信息以符號標記、乾淨的每因子「神諭」代碼或糾纏的感知向量的方式到達Transformer，會影響它是否以組合方式綁定該信息？我們研究了在有限的因子世界中，參數約為6-10K的Transformer，這些世界被徹底列舉，因此每次測量涵蓋整個輸入空間（零採樣方差），而信息路徑是信息匹配的（精確的貝葉斯上限為1.0）。我們報告了四項發現。(1) 終點不變性：在保留的綁定查詢中，沒有信息路徑達到收斂的零-shot 組合——每個結束於或低於機會，儘管上限為1.0，因此在有限的範圍內，失敗反映了在查找充足目標下的歸納偏差，而不是缺失信息。(2) 少量綁定的雙因子解釋：樣本效率最好由輸入通路參數共享和代碼可讀性解釋；一個維度匹配的控制和一個分級可讀性掃描將可讀性與輸入維度隔離，而乾淨的神諭並不是最具樣本效率的可讀路徑。(3) 雙重解離：在訓練早期，分佈式——但不是索引類似的——代碼經歷了一個短暫的高於機會階段（跟踪代碼格式），而少量樣本效率則跟踪通路共享。(4) 失敗解剖：符號路徑在讀出時失去答案；索引路徑錯誤綁定（答案仍然可解碼，但輸入干預顯示輸出跟踪錯誤的槽位）；糾纏路徑繼承其輸入的可讀性。核心主張是雙因子解釋；終點和解剖結果是診斷約束。所有代碼、清單和每個種子的日誌都已發布以便精確重現。
2607.04926.author: Yoshiyuki Ootani et.al.
